patterns: how do i apply for admission
how can i get admission into this college
is there an entrance exam for admission
what percentage do i need for admission
responses: Admissions open in June every year. You'll need your 12th marksheet, ID proof, and entrance exam score. Apply via the official admissions portal.

patterns: what time does the library open
is the library open on sunday
can i visit the library at night
is the library open on public holidays
how late is the library open during exams
is the reading room open now
responses: The library is open Monday to Saturday, 8 AM to 9 PM. It's closed on Sundays and public holidays. During exam weeks it stays open until midnight.

patterns: when does the semester exam start
when is the mid semester exam
how do i download my admit card
responses: End-semester exams usually start in the last week of November and April. The exact timetable is published on the college website a month in advance.

patterns: how much is the tuition fee
how do i pay my fees
can i pay fees in installments
how to get a fee receipt
is there a fine for late payment
hostel fee vs tuition fee difference
responses: Semester fees are due within the first two weeks of each semester and can be paid online through the student portal. A late fee applies after the deadline.

patterns: how do i apply for hostel
is hostel available for first years
how to get a hostel room
can i change my hostel room
is there wifi in the hostel
is ac room available in hostel
responses: Hostel applications open after admission confirmation. Rooms are allotted on a first-come basis, and the curfew is 10 PM on weekdays.

patterns: how many students got placed last year
do core companies visit for placement
placement training and soft skills sessions
responses: The placement cell organizes drives starting in the 7th semester. Past recruiters include a mix of product, service, and core companies across various packages.

patterns: how do i contact the college
who do i talk to for a complaint
who is the point of contact for international students
responses: You can reach the college office at info@college.edu or visit the admin block between 9 AM and 5 PM on working days.

patterns: am i eligible for a scholarship
how do i apply for a scholarship
is there a scholarship for sc st students
how much scholarship amount can i get
responses: Merit and need-based scholarships are announced at the start of each academic year. Applications go through the National Scholarship Portal or the college's own financial aid office, depending on the scheme.

patterns: is there a college bus service
how much does the bus pass cost
which areas does the college bus cover
how do i apply for a bus pass
is there a bus from the railway station
responses: College buses run on fixed routes covering major parts of the city, with morning and evening trips on working days. Bus passes are issued at the transport office at the start of each semester.

patterns: wifi is not working in my hostel
how do i connect to campus wifi
internet is very slow on campus
how do i reset my student portal password
who do i contact for it support
how to register a new device on campus wifi
responses: For wifi or portal issues, raise a ticket with the IT helpdesk at ithelp@college.edu or visit the IT support desk in the main block. Most login issues are resolved within a day.

patterns: i want to file a complaint
there's an issue with my hostel room
how to escalate an unresolved issue
where can i submit feedback about a professor
how to raise an anonymous complaint
responses: You can file a complaint through the student grievance portal, or contact the grievance redressal cell directly for sensitive matters like ragging or harassment, which are handled confidentially and on priority.
